prior_method: Unsupervised labels and SHA do not prove narrative truth. PR #69 failed real semantic inverse.

calibration.lesson: A character's wish for a resource's healing effect is a belief until its effect is observed.
Physical improvement consumes scarce resources; one person's choice can impose costs on others.
Official access requirements differ from exceptions granted through personal influence or discretionary decisions; an exception does not repeal the general rule.
The focal child lacks information available to some other people; do not transfer a narrator's knowledge or a rumour into the child's mind.
Coincidence and repeatable effects can support a suspected trigger while leaving the actual mechanism unknown.
Pressure from ongoing off-screen conflict can alter institutions and ordinary lives independently of the protagonist.

test_world.genre: science-fantasy colony; all roles and places relabeled, no novel names
observations: Large population center and regional administration.
Public citadel gate is open but staffed with armed watchers.
Watchers and trained beasts have regular independent shifts.
Ordinary residents avoid the citadel despite an open entry.
A small secluded yard lies inside the government compound.
Child attends an evaluation but does not know its consequences.
Director commissioned several advisers to assess young dependent.
Advisers judge child not inclined toward governance.
Specialist believes child's physical system cannot store internal power conventionally.
Child does not understand the specialist or leadership terms.
Director assigns distant research outpost and security crew to child.
Child likes remote scenery and believes outpost is an ordinary gift.
Director's reassuring expression masks private grief.
Classified room receives only senior council, not child.
Director and advisers discuss a consequential operation outside child hearing.
Child is sent away before classified discussion.
Director's family commands frontier military and territory.
Dangerous frontier ecology and defensive forces exist without child observing.
Remote outpost lies amid highland paths.
Incidental pregnant worker carries supplies up a rough path.
Child tries to help worker, overextends and trips, without major injury.
Concealed patrol follows child and does not interrupt this small mishap.
Patrol does not know director's classified aims.
Child treasures rare older-sibling visit and is lonely when it ends.
Sibling inadvertently reveals time spent training with director.
Child concludes absent director no longer values them.
Child wants director's personal praise more than public authority.
Child wonders whether all effective fighting disciplines require internal power storage.
Child decides to try an alternative training route rather than accept the prevailing judgment.
Unseen patrol continues following after child's decision.
questions: Separate narrated conditions, reported judgements, character beliefs and unknown facts.
Reconstruct world conditions existing independently of P0 and important small-scale actors.
Deduce why P0 changed intended behavior, noting knowledge limitations and uncertainty about success.
P0 thinks the director no longer cares. Is this objectively established? Justify.
What can plausibly happen when the child requests unconventional training, without asserting a compulsory future?
Counterfactual: P0 no longer wants parental praise and instead values simple trade. Which choices may change? Which independent world constraints persist?
State which exact later teachers, secret plans and technical results cannot be derived from these prefix observations.
